name: No_7
short_caption: The robot spreads both arms outward with open palms to express negation or a lack of something.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing posture. It smoothly raises both arms symmetrically, bending at the elbows, and rotates its wrists to present open, upward-facing palms while spreading its arms slightly outward. It holds this open-handed gesture briefly before bringing both arms back down to the neutral rest position.
safety_notes: The robot sweeps both arms outward; ensure there are no obstacles immediately to its left or right.
